title: ZeroLag
description: A lightweight, ultra-optimized Fabric modpack focusing on maximum FPS performance, engine stabilization, and seamless vanilla+ quality-of-life enhancements.
body:
![ZeroLag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5fd70d6d26a8109da5eb4ab8325acbed2c4097f7.png)

---

**ZeroLag** is a cutting-edge optimization pack built for Fabric that extracts every drop of performance out of your game while maintaining a clean, highly functional Vanilla+ feel. Whether you are running on a high-end rig or a low-spec laptop, this pack stabilizes your frame rates, fixes underlying engine bugs, and modernizes your gameplay experience.

---

## 🚀 Key Features

### 💻 Ultimate Performance & Engine Fixes

We feature industry-standard optimization mods alongside advanced engine improvements to ensure smooth, responsive, and stutter-free gameplay:

* **Rendering & Logic:** Powered by modern rendering optimizations to dramatically improve frame rates and frame consistency.
* **Memory & Optimization:** Includes advanced memory management and performance enhancements to reduce overhead and improve stability.
* **Culling Tweaks:** Intelligent culling systems prevent unnecessary rendering of hidden entities, blocks, and other visual elements.
* **Engine Enhancements:** Multi-threaded world loading, optimized game logic, and faster world generation help Minecraft run more efficiently.
* **Bug Fixes:** Comprehensive vanilla bug fixes and gameplay improvements provide a more polished experience.

### 🛠️ Vanilla+ Quality of Life & UI Updates

Performance means nothing if the game isn't comfortable to play. ZeroLag includes carefully selected quality-of-life improvements while remaining lightweight and unobtrusive:

* **Quality of Life:** Helpful gameplay utilities, inventory improvements, recipe viewing, and interface enhancements designed to make everyday gameplay smoother.
* **Clean Interface:** A refined UI experience with optional dark-themed elements and improved menu presentation.
* **Custom Menus:** Includes multiple custom panorama backgrounds to give the pack a unique identity while keeping the vanilla aesthetic intact.
* **Cactus Mod Client:** Access utility features by pressing **Right Shift (`RShift`)**; to learn more about its capabilities, visit their official page [here](https://modrinth.com/mod/cactus).
* **Privacy & Safety:** Includes features that help preserve the traditional multiplayer chat experience while maintaining compatibility with modern servers.

---

## 📦 Manual Recommendation Note

To comply with platform restrictions, a few highly recommended client-side optimizations are hosted under restrictive licenses. For the absolute best stability against VRAM issues, we highly recommend manually downloading:

* **[Fix GPU Memory Leak](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fix-gpu-memory-leak)** from CurseForge and placing it directly into your local `mods/` folder.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration & Keybinds

ZeroLag ships pre-configured with streamlined settings designed for optimal performance right out of the box. Most options can be customized through **Mod Menu**, powered behind the scenes by **YetAnotherConfigLib** and **Cloth Config API**.

Whether you're playing on integrated graphics, a gaming laptop, or a high-end desktop, ZeroLag is designed to deliver a fast, stable, and hassle-free Minecraft experience.

---

### 🚀 ZeroLag Philosophy

**Less clutter. More FPS.**
